lens_fraction_band.stop_condition: a run STOPS if its realised run-mean lens fraction differs from its exact expected value by more than 0.002, or if any target batch is not exactly 256 items with no duplicates

measurement_lockout: the new frozen and FreeMatch x nb3 runners persist logits without computing test metrics; only the step-0 gates (and each frozen stage's end-of-run gate_values.json) measure. Stricter than the original runners; it cannot affect training, because the replaced curve hook uses no RNG and its output was only printed

num_workers_declared.coral_frozen: not applicable: train_coral_fold builds no DataLoader (samplers index cached feature tensors), so no worker RNG exists
num_workers_declared.source: each original run's recorded num_workers (Kaggle, with workers)

rng_coupling.finding: target sampling shares no random stream with source sampling, augmentation or torch's global RNG; the source batch index sequence was bit-identical for 2000 steps on all six arms and folds 1-4
rng_coupling.residual: FreeMatch x nb3's larger SAT rebuild (680 vs 160 target batches) advances torch's in-process RNG only when num_workers=0; it is removed by declaring the original worker counts and refusing 0

threshold_statuses.rule: a threshold that would already fire at steps 0-10, or is degenerate (e.g. a BNM floor at or below 0), becomes ADVISORY with its reason; it is never loosened until it can no longer fire. Every other threshold keeps its original status. 'Fires' is judged on any single step, ignoring the sustain window (the stricter reading).
